description.en: Fresh sandwich bread layered with grilled halloumi cheese, crisp lettuce, tomato, and cucumber slices. Enhanced with a mint mayonnaise spread and a drizzle of pesto, topped with roasted tomato garlic for added flavor.

Crisp falafel served on a slice of tartine bread, topped with creamy cheese and a rich Tahini Gremolata sauce. Garnished with fresh rocca leaves, mint, basil, parsley, and a sprinkle of radish slices for a fresh bite.

Creamy mashed avocado spread on a crisp tartine toast, layered with a spicy mix of labneh infused with red and green chillies and a splash of lemon juice. Topped with chili flakes, roasted sesame, and fresh parsley and dill for added flavor.

Tartine bread topped with a blend of grilled eggplant and avocado, seasoned with lemon, salt, and pepper. Garnished with bruschetta tomatoes, roasted sesame seeds, micro herbs, and a drizzle of balsamic.

A rich assortment featuring Foul Medames seasoned with traditional spices, complemented by Falafel, Mutabal, sunnyside-up eggs, and Halloumi Carpaccio on sliced tomatoes. Served with fresh Arabic bread and a side of smoked Mutabal.
A traditional English breakfast with two sausages, three scrambled eggs, and turkey bacon. Includes a mix of fried mushrooms, baked red beans, and two slices of golden-browned French bread.
Poached eggs on a bed of creamy labneh, enhanced with a unique blend of spices including paprika, cumin, and chili flakes, garnished with sumac, cumin, and dill leaves, served with toasted bread.

Smoked eggplant blended with our secret tzatziki sauce, garnished with sumac, white sesame seeds, and pomegranate seeds. Served on toasted bread with a topping of roasted almonds and fresh parsley and mint leaves.
Scrambled eggs combined with sautéed mushrooms, onions, and garlic, served on toasted bread. Garnished with micro herbs, mixed rocca and radish, and cherry tomatoes.
A classic omelette made with three eggs and cooking cream, accompanied by a side salad and a slice of toasted bread.
Silky poached eggs served on a plush potato bun, topped with fresh avocado mash and our signature Hollandaise sauce, seasoned with a hint of chili flakes.
A rich blend of eggs poached in a spiced tomato sauce, featuring diced tomatoes, white onion, and a hint of chili labneh for a creamy finish. Garnished with fresh cherry tomatoes.
A hearty lentil soup enriched with a variety of vegetables, seasoned with a blend of Middle Eastern spices for an aromatic finish.
A comforting soup featuring tender broccoli and a rich cheese blend, enhanced with a mix of fresh vegetables.
Our rich and velvety mushroom soup prepared with mushrooms sautéed in Danish butter, mixed with vegetables, broth, and a splash of cream for a comforting finish.
Tender chicken tossed in hickory BBQ sauce, combined with crispy lettuce, mixed beans, lemon juice, and a drizzle of ranch BBQ sauce for a smoky and satisfying salad.
A vibrant mix featuring tri-color quinoa, mango, pomegranate, and avocado, tossed with mixed beans, corn, and drizzled with ranch dressing for a healthy, flavorful salad.
A delightful blend of crispy German-style breaded chicken served atop a classic Caesar salad for a savory twist on a traditional favorite.
